title: 数据科学与机器学习笔记本项目
summary: 该项目包含作者在Nodebook数据科学与机器学习项目中完成的实战项目，涵盖Python、机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式AI和AI智能体，展示了构建能思考、规划和行动的智能系统的经验。
summary_en: This project contains real-world projects completed in the Nodebook Data Science & Machine Learning program, covering Python, ML, Deep Learning, LLMs, Generative AI, and AI Agents, demonstrating hands-on experience in building smart systems that can think, plan, and act.
